receipt_validation: separate independent review; this review hashes local source files only
evidence_convention: source label resolves path and SHA-256 above; ranges are inclusive one-based lines

findings.observation: No terminator; lstrip and special documented. Negative sizing, overflow and null-buffer sizing not documented. Do not borrow detokenize contract.

Original size >= INT32_MAX aborts before stripping. Strip up to positive lstrip ASCII spaces; insufficient length returns negative post-strip required bytes without copying; otherwise memcpy exact size and return size.

No null-buffer guard. Nonempty piece with zero capacity returns negative size in common path; empty piece reaches memcpy with size zero. Portable null/zero sizing not qualified; use live one-byte buffer.

Attribute .at lookup occurs before explicit ID range branch; no stable invalid-ID error return. No null-vocab wrapper guard. Common oversize abort is not tokenize INT32_MIN semantics. Uncached RWKV casts length to size_t and sizes to int; forbid negative capacities.

special=false suppresses UNKNOWN/CONTROL, not USER_DEFINED. Cache built with special=true; private grammar reads that cache. Use special=true and lstrip=0 for byte comparison matching grammar. Uncached RWKV/direct PLaMo byte branch bypasses common lstrip helper.

Nonnegative success count, negative required count on short buffer, INT32_MIN overflow. Exact implementation uses >= INT32_MAX threshold and builds full result before capacity check. No token writes on short capacity. Validate nonnegative text lengths/capacities; check sentinel before wide negation; output capacity does not bound internal allocation.

add_special=false disables automatic insertions but not transformations. parse_special=false still prepartitions USER_DEFINED tokens and LSTRIP/RSTRIP can discard whitespace. SPM can prefix a space independently; WordPiece/Unigram normalize; TEST hashes input. Universal exact byte roundtrip is not guaranteed.

EOG is membership in configured/text-derived set with model-specific removals, not just EOS/EOT. Enumerate every valid ID via is_eog after independently bounding public n_vocab. Loaded vocabulary identities/count remain unknown.

EOG branches before piece decoding and does not consume rendered bytes. Precheck and disposition any EOG ID inside input tokens even if byte roundtrip matches; keep EOG probes separate and never accept EOG for recognition.

Public grammar init is non-lazy. Null/empty grammar yields non-null sampler with null inner grammar; callbacks no-op. Generic apply/accept quietly tolerate null sampler. Require nonempty grammar, explicit root, nonnull init and behavioral controls.

Apply has const grammar and filters every supplied candidate; no finite-logit guard. Use finite 0.0f starting logit to observe -INFINITY. Accept changes stacks/partial UTF8 and can throw after rejection. EOG allowed on any empty stack, and accepting EOG without one aborts.

Partial decoder state persists between pieces, but decoder uses c_str/zero terminators and is not a strict full UTF8 validator. New sequence continuation loop does not apply previous-partial continuation-form check. EOG empty-stack checks have no explicit partial state guard. Require independent strict input UTF8/no raw NUL and record prefix EOG conformance rather than assume it.

Apply filters leading-NUL non-EOG pieces, while decoder stops at any NUL. No explicit scan rejects internal NUL followed by bytes, so a hypothetical token-piece suffix could be invisible. Whether the approved vocabulary contains such pieces is unknown; no runtime scan performed. Future bounded piece checks should record raw lengths and NUL positions.

CLI reads binary file then may process escapes; stdin may process escapes; flags derive from model/params and common wrappers. It creates a context despite vocab_only. Human piece printing uses c_str and platform-specific rendering, so it is not the proposed no-context counted-byte harness.

proposed_finite_procedure.authorization: none; later separately reviewed protocol only
proposed_finite_procedure.numeric_caps_status: must be frozen before runtime authorization; this review does not invent approved values
proposed_finite_procedure.retry_policy: once after sentinel-first checked wide required-size conversion and prospective policy cap; exact retry size must agree
proposed_finite_procedure.roundtrip_policy: compare counted exact concatenated piece bytes to original; no trimming, normalization, repair, flag switching or reserialization
input_prevalidation: no EOG IDs inside document token stream
proposed_finite_procedure.layer_reporting: independent UTF8/NUL precheck, byte roundtrip and EOG-stream exclusion are harness-layer dispositions; do not label them native document rejection
proposed_finite_procedure.corpus_policy: frozen corpus unchanged; no repair, replacement or normalization
proposed_finite_procedure.membership_policy: fresh non-lazy grammar per document; apply then inspect candidate; accept only admitted non-EOG actual token; stop at first rejection
proposed_finite_procedure.eog_policy: enumerate all valid IDs once; probe every EOG after input and at bounded prefix controls with finite candidate logit; never accept any EOG
proposed_finite_procedure.prefix_control_requirement: include token-boundary incomplete multibyte state and do not assume character EOF equals vocabulary EOG
proposed_finite_procedure.resource_limit: output caps do not bound internal full-vector tokenizer allocations or vocabulary cache construction; separately reviewed process boundary required
proposed_finite_procedure.cleanup: all document samplers before vocabulary-owning model and DLL
